references.text: The Kohathite clan is mentioned first among the Levites, and their numbering and service are especially highlighted.
The following verse explains how the Kohathites are to be protected from dying when they approach the most holy things.
The people of Israel feared being wiped out when they approached the tabernacle, which shows the seriousness of the warning not to let the Kohathite clan be destroyed.
Nadab and Abihu died when they approached the Lord in the wrong way, illustrating the danger that the Kohathites faced.
The clans of the Kohathites and their responsibility for the holy objects in the tabernacle are described here.
Kohath's sons are mentioned in the genealogy of Moses and Aaron, showing the origin of the Kohathites.
